Uniform small/large gap bounds force maximizing gaps compact; local C² convergence to nondegenerate unique maximizer of f yields eventually unique optimizer. Exact rational example and delivered standard-library checker test nonstandard algebra. Uncalibrated source weights admit exact aliases, correctly delimited.
